sum: Credits pay for crafting, blueprints and mod fusion; The Index on Neptune is the go-to farm, with Profit-Taker and Techrot Safes paying even more for veterans.

ways.how: Pick the High Risk investment (50,000 credits), collect Index Points from killed enemies and bank them faster than the Corpus team. Keep going for more rounds before extracting.
ways.why: Each High Risk round you win pays 250,000 credits, and the game is built around wagering, so it is the best credit farm for newer players. A Credit Booster increases the payout.

ways.how: Run the Vox Solaris heist and defeat the Profit-Taker Orb atop the Enrichment Labs in the Orb Vallis.
ways.why: The kill drops 125,000 credits as a pickup, so Chroma's Effigy, Credit Boosters, a Credit Blessing and Prosperous/Loyal Retriever all multiply it.
ways.req: Old Mate rank with Solaris United, an Archgun with Gravimag, and a strong loadout

ways.how: Find and open the Techrot Safe in a Höllvania mission. Shell Cracker bounties mark the safe on your map, and the Orokin Eye Air Support highlights its key.
ways.why: A safe gives 100,000 Höllars (credits) as a pickup, so every multiplier stacks on it: with Effigy, a Credit Blessing and a Retriever proc it shows 450,000, and a Credit Booster doubles that to 900,000.

ways.how: Play the Disruption mission on Laomedeia and clear rounds quickly.
ways.why: It awards 30,000 credits per B rotation and 50,000 per C rotation, and fast teams can out-earn The Index. These are Credit Caches, so boosters apply but the Daily First Win Bonus does not.

ways.how: Make an Arbitration your first mission after the Daily Tribute, and finish all three Sortie missions each day.
ways.why: Arbitrations always pay 50,000 credits per completion, which the Daily First Win Bonus doubles to 100,000. Sorties pay 100,000 credits in total once per day.
ways.req: Arbitrations: Pluto access and the Eris junction lens task. Sorties: MR5 and The War Within

ways.how: Run Hieracon Excavation and extract after the first excavator finishes, or do Sechura (Pluto), Seimeni or Gabii (Ceres) for 5 minutes or 3 waves.
ways.why: Hieracon pays 20,000 credits in under 5 minutes, and the other Dark Sectors also pay 20,000 for a short run. Each extra squad member adds about 1,000.

ways.how: Clear Railjack missions solo, such as all of Earth Proxima, or Neptune and Pluto Proxima for a bit more pay.
ways.why: Missions usually pay 30,000-40,000 credits each, Neptune and Pluto Proxima at least 50,000, and Veil Proxima at least 100,000 at much higher enemy levels.

tips: A Credit Booster doubles credit gains, and Login Tribute boosters extend an active one.
Ask an MR30 player in a Relay for a Credit Blessing: 25% more credits for 3 hours.
Chroma's Effigy doubles big pickups like the Profit-Taker and Techrot Safe drops.
Sell spare blueprints, mods and Captura scenes from your inventory; use the 'sellable only' filter.

sum: Endo ranks up your mods; the fastest farm is Steel Path Rathuum on Sedna with a loot squad, and Arbitrations are a strong steady source.

ways.how: Run the Rathuum arena at Yam or Vodyanoi on Sedna in The Steel Path, ideally with a full squad. Bring loot frames such as Nekros with Despoil, Nidus, or Khora with Pilfering Strangledome.
ways.why: The Steel Path doubles Mod and Endo drop chance, and a squad with loot frames can reach upwards of 75,000 Endo per hour.

ways.how: Stay in an Arbitration for an hour or more, collecting rotation rewards that include Endo and Ayatan Sculptures.
ways.why: With one reward every 5 minutes, an hour averages about 11,796 Endo (counting filled Ayatan Sculptures). Staying longer earns more.
ways.req: Pluto access and the Eris junction lens task

ways.how: Complete all three Sortie missions each day.
ways.why: The reward can be 4,000 Endo, an Anasa Ayatan Sculpture worth 3,450 Endo when filled, a Legendary Core (saves up to 40,920 Endo) or a 3-day Mod Drop Chance Booster.
ways.req: MR5, The War Within, and Oro (Earth) completed

ways.how: Buy the rotating 30,000 Endo offering from Teshin in any Relay when it appears.
ways.why: 30,000 Endo for 150 Steel Essence, available once every 8 weeks.

ways.how: Do Maroo's weekly treasure hunt from her Bazaar on Mars (it resets every Monday), then fill and cash in the sculpture.
ways.why: A guaranteed sculpture worth 1,425-2,700 Endo once filled with Ayatan Stars, and it can be traded instead.

ways.how: Run high-level bounties such as the Cambion Drift 40-60 bounty, scrap unwanted Railjack salvage, and dissolve duplicate mods in your Orbiter.
ways.why: The Cambion Drift 40-60 bounty has a 45.45% chance of 1,000 Endo on stage 1. Railjack components scrap for 75-300 Endo by Mk tier, and the Daily Synthesis task gives 250-800.

tips: Only the Mod Drop Chance Booster affects Endo; Resource Boosters and Relay blessings do nothing for it.
Fill Ayatan Sculptures with stars before giving them to Maroo to get the full value.
Use Legendary Cores on Primed or Umbra mods, where they save the most Endo.
Enemy Endo orbs come in 15, 50 and 80 sizes.

sum: Kuva cycles Riven mods and builds rare blueprints; Kuva Floods are the main farm, topped up by weekly vendor buys from Steel Essence, Riven Slivers and Voidplumes.

ways.how: Do the Kuva Flood mission on the planet the Kuva Fortress is orbiting, catching Kuva clouds with Operator Void Beam or Void Sling.
ways.why: Each Flood awards 1,100-1,400 Kuva, double a regular Siphon, and Resource Boosters apply.

ways.how: Run the regular Kuva Siphon missions marked with the Kuva icon near the Kuva Fortress.
ways.why: Each destroyed Siphon gives around 550-700 Kuva at an easier level 25-35.

ways.how: Trade Steel Essence to Teshin in any Relay for Kuva packs.
ways.why: 10,000 Kuva for 15 Steel Essence, up to 25 times per week (250,000 total). The rotating 50,000-for-55 offer every 8 weeks gives more per Essence.

ways.how: Grab the weekly Kuva offers: Palladino in Iron Wake, Archimedean Yonta in the Chrysalith, plus Flare, Acrithis, Nightcap, Aspirant Zorba and Cephalon Melica.
ways.why: Palladino and Yonta each sell 35,000 Kuva weekly (10 Riven Slivers or 5 Voidplume Pinions). Several others sell 6,000 a pack up to 7 times a week (42,000 each).
ways.req: Varies by vendor (e.g. Chains of Harrow for Palladino)

ways.t: Steel Path Circuit, Archon Hunts and Sorties
ways.how: Pick Kuva as a Steel Path Circuit tier reward, and complete weekly Archon Hunts and daily Sorties.
ways.why: The Circuit offers 20,000 Kuva at tier 5 or 10 once per week. Archon Hunts have a 12% chance of 12,000, Sorties 12% for 6,000.
ways.req: The Steel Path; Veilbreaker for Archon Hunts

ways.how: Run Cetus, Fortuna or Necralisk bounties, or Kuva Survival on Taveuni and Disruption on Tamu.
ways.why: Bounties pay 100-300 (Cetus), 500 (Fortuna) and 750 (Necralisk). Tamu Disruption gives 100/200/350 per A/B/C tier, plus 50 per Demolisher.

tips: Resource Boosters double Siphon and Flood Kuva, but not Tamu Disruption rotation rewards.
Spend Nightwave Creds on the 10,000 Kuva offering (50 Creds) when spare.
Arbitration Honors sell 10,000 Kuva for 25 Vitus Essence.
Parazon-finishing a Kuva Lich drops 150-300 Kuva depending on its rank.

sum: Ducats buy Baro Ki'Teer's exclusive items; you get them by selling Prime parts at the Ducat kiosks in any Relay, and gold (rare) parts pay the most.

ways.t: Sell Prime parts at Relay kiosks
ways.how: Open Void Relics, then sell spare Prime blueprints, weapon parts and crafted Prime Warframe components at the Void Trader kiosks in any Relay's Concourse.
ways.why: Common (bronze) parts are worth 15 Ducats, uncommon (silver) 45 and rare (gold) 100. The kiosks are always open, even when Baro is away.

ways.t: Crack Radiant relics for gold parts
ways.how: Refine relics with Void Traces and run Fissures in a squad, focusing on getting rare drops to sell.
ways.why: A single rare part is worth 100 Ducats, almost seven commons.

ways.t: Buy cheap Prime parts from players
ways.how: Buy unwanted Prime parts cheaply from other players in trade chat, then sell them at the kiosks.
ways.why: Ducats themselves cannot be traded, but the parts can, so this turns Platinum into Ducats.
ways.req: MR2 and Two-Factor Authentication to trade

ways.how: Exchange Aya with Varzia in Maroo's Bazaar for Ducats.
ways.why: A way to turn spare Aya into Ducats without opening relics.

ways.how: Buy the Void Surplus that Baro Ki'Teer sells once per visit for 50,000 credits.
ways.why: It has a 2% chance to contain 1,000 Ducats, so it is a small bonus, not a main source.

tips: Parts that were rarer on vaulted relics but are common on newer ones are worth 25 or 65 Ducats.
Crafted Prime Warframe parts can still go to the kiosk, but they can no longer be traded to players, so decide before you build.
Stockpile Ducats before Baro arrives so you can buy his items right away.

sum: Platinum is the premium currency; outside of buying it, the way to earn it is trading tradable items (Prime parts and sets, Mods, Arcanes, Rivens, Relics) with other players.

ways.t: Sell Prime parts and full sets
ways.how: Open Void Relics and sell Prime blueprints and weapon parts in trade chat or Maroo's Bazaar. Full sets include the main blueprint plus every part.
ways.why: Prime parts are the most common tradable reward, and players buy them to skip the relic farm. Vaulted relics stay tradable too.

ways.how: Unveil Riven Mods from Sorties and other sources and sell the ones you won't use.
ways.why: Rivens are tradable and unique to each roll, so a good one can sell for a lot.

ways.how: Sell spare Arcane Enhancements (ranked or unranked) and tradable mods from your farms.
ways.why: Arcanes and many mods are tradable, so leftovers from Eidolons, bounties and Arbitrations turn into Platinum.

ways.t: Sell Syndicate gear, Ayatans and other tradables
ways.how: Sell Syndicate weapons, armor and emotes, Ayatan Sculptures, relics and other items in the tradable list.
ways.why: Spare Syndicate standing turns into Platinum this way. Tradable weapons sell as long as they have no affinity, Forma, Lens or Catalyst.

ways.how: Post WTS offers in the in-game Trade chat, set up shop in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars, or meet in a Clan Dojo trading post.
ways.why: Maroo's Bazaar has a fixed 10% hub tax on top of the credit trade tax, while a Dojo can charge 0-100%.

tips: You get daily trades equal to your Mastery Rank; ranking up gives one more immediately.
Starting and giveaway Platinum can't be traded, only bought or traded Platinum.
Baro Ki'Teer's arrival can crash prices for his items, and vaulting changes relic prices.
Double-check item names, mod ranks and the Platinum amount before clicking OK; trades can't be undone.

sum: Void Traces refine relics to Radiant and craft Dragon Keys; you earn them from Reactant in Void Fissures, and an endless Fissure with boosters is the fastest farm.

ways.how: Run an endless Fissure, ideally Defense where Reactant is easy to collect, and pick up 10 Reactant each rotation.
ways.why: Each relic opening gives 6-30 Traces. Endless missions also hand out bonus Resource Boosters, and with every multiplier one relic can give up to 495.

ways.how: Run Fissure missions with no relic equipped (solo or with a premade squad) and collect 10 Reactant.
ways.why: You still get the 6-30 Traces without spending your relics.

ways.t: Public squads where others pick your reward
ways.how: Open relics in squads; when teammates pick the reward from your relic you get bonus Traces.
ways.why: 5 bonus Traces per teammate who picks yours, up to 15 extra.

ways.how: Spend a Granum Crown at a Golden Hand Tribute on a Corpus Ship and kill Errant Specters.
ways.why: The Rank 1 reward includes 5/10/15 Traces for Normal/Extended/Nightmare.

ways.how: Trade Aya to Varzia in Maroo's Bazaar for Void Traces.
ways.why: Turns spare Aya into Traces when you need them.

tips: Your cap is MR x 50 + 100 (750 at MR13, 1,600 at MR30); extra is lost.
Resource Boosters, Resource Weekends and Loyal/Resourceful Retriever all double the Trace reward.
Radiant costs 100 Traces, Flawless 50, Exceptional 25.

sum: Aya buys vaulted relics from Varzia's Prime Resurgence; it drops from Void missions and bounties, taking the place of vaulted relics.

ways.how: Run missions on Void nodes; each completion guarantees either a relic or Aya.
ways.why: Aya drops in place of vaulted relics, so Void missions are the steady source.

ways.how: Run open-world bounties such as Cetus, Fortuna and Necralisk ones.
ways.why: Aya replaces vaulted relics in bounty reward tables too.

ways.how: Open Relic Packs from Syndicate offerings or the in-game Market.
ways.why: Packs occasionally contain Aya.

tips: Varzia also trades Aya for Ducats and Void Traces.
Faction Syndicates need 2 Aya for Rank 4 and 3 for Rank 5, so keep a few.
Varzia's stock changes every 28 days at 18:00 UTC; check before spending.

sum: Regal Aya buys vaulted Prime Warframes, weapons and accessories directly from Varzia; it is only sold for real money and can't be traded.

ways.how: Purchase Regal Aya packs at the Prime Resurgence page on the official Warframe website.
ways.why: Packs come with bonus Platinum (up to 1,200 in the largest pack).

ways.how: Buy Regal Aya through the in-game Market on any platform.
ways.why: Same product, available without leaving the game.

ways.how: Farm regular Aya from Void missions and bounties and buy the vaulted relics, then open them yourself.
ways.why: Gets the same vaulted Primes without paying, at the cost of relic farming.

tips: Items bought with Regal Aya come with a slot and a Catalyst or Reactor installed.
Buying from Varzia bypasses Mastery Rank locks on Prime weapons.
Prime accessories like Syandanas and Sugatras are Regal Aya only.

sum: Riven Slivers buy Rivens, Kuva and Requiem items from Palladino; they drop from Eximus units, so Eximus-heavy Steel Path missions with resource boosts are the best farm.

ways.how: Run endless Steel Path missions and kill every Eximus, stacking resource drop bonuses.
ways.why: Eximus above level 30 have a 2% chance to drop one, and the Steel Path's bonus drop chance raises that further.

ways.how: Do Sorties or Abyssal Zone Orokin Defixios with the Eximus Stronghold condition.
ways.why: Eximus spawn much more often, so more chances at a Sliver.

ways.how: Play Höllvania missions, especially Faceoff where opponents can spawn 5 Eximus with Eximus Influx.
ways.why: Eximus spawn at an increased rate in Höllvania.

ways.how: Open Requiem Relics in Void Fissures and run Empyrean missions.
ways.why: Both list Riven Slivers as rewards.

ways.how: Fight Jackal at level 41+ (Sortie or Steel Path).
ways.why: 5% chance to drop 1 Sliver.
ways.req: The Steel Path or a Sortie

tips: Slivers count as resources: Resource Boosters, Drop Chance Boosters, Retriever mods, Atlas Ore Gaze, Khora Pilfering Strangledome and Wukong all help.
Pick them up fast; Sliver drops despawn after about 2 minutes.
Spend 10 on Palladino's 35,000 Kuva each week, or on a Riven Mod (10 Slivers, twice a week).
Operation: Belly of the Beast, when it runs, is full of Jade Light Eximus.

sum: Steel Essence buys Teshin's Steel Path Honors (Umbra Forma, Kuva, arcane adapters and more); daily Incursions plus Acolyte kills are the core farm.

ways.how: Clear the six daily Steel Path Incursion alerts.
ways.why: Each gives 5 Steel Essence, 30 per day.

ways.how: Stay in endless Steel Path missions and kill the Acolytes that spawn, grabbing the drops quickly.
ways.why: Each Acolyte guarantees 2 Steel Essence, doubled by Resource Boosters and Loyal/Resourceful Retriever.

ways.how: Reach Tier 9 of the Steel Path Circuit and floor 18 of Steel Path Descendia each week.
ways.why: 25 Steel Essence each.

ways.t: Clearing the Steel Path Star Chart
ways.how: Complete every node on each planet in The Steel Path.
ways.why: 25 per planet cleared, 475 for the whole Star Chart, a one-time haul.

ways.t: Steel Path Fissures, Orowyrm and Eidolons
ways.how: Open relics in Steel Path Fissures, beat the Orowyrm in Steel Path Duviri, and hunt Eidolons on the Steel Path Plains.
ways.why: 1 per relic opened, 5 from the Orowyrm chest, 1 per Eidolon. Steel Path Undercroft portals give 2 each, up to 6 per run.

tips: Run endless Steel Path with a Resource Booster active to double Acolyte drops.
Grab Acolyte drops right away; they often vanish within 1-3 minutes.
Buying everything in Teshin's permanent stock once takes 408 Essence.

sum: Vitus Essence buys Arbitration Honors (Galvanized mods, arcanes, Kuva and more); it comes only from Arbitrations, so stay long and kill Shield Drones.

ways.how: Stay in an endless Arbitration for many rotations; after the first four, every rotation is a C rotation.
ways.why: Each rotation gives 1 guaranteed Vitus, plus a 10% chance of 3 more from the reward table.
ways.req: Pluto access, the Eris junction lens task, and a Rank 30 Warframe

ways.how: Kill every Arbitration Shield Drone and grab what it drops.
ways.why: Each drone has a 6% chance to drop 1 Vitus, which Resource Boosters and Retriever mods double.

ways.how: Pick Arbitrations on Survival, Defense or Interception.
ways.why: Survival and Defense rotations are short, so Vitus comes faster. Excavation needs two digs per reward.

tips: Use a Resource Booster to double Vitus from Shield Drones.
Failing still keeps rotation rewards already earned; quitting does not.
Drone Vitus can disappear within 1-3 minutes, so pick it up fast.
Buying everything in the Honors shop once takes 1,125 Vitus.

sum: Pathos Clamps buy Drifter melee weapons, Incarnon upgrades and Acrithis' wares; Steel Path Duviri Experience with Undercroft side portals is the best farm.

ways.t: Steel Path Duviri Experience + Undercroft portals
ways.how: Play The Duviri Experience on Steel Path, clear the Undercroft side portals, and beat the Orowyrm at the end.
ways.why: The Orowyrm chest gives 15 Clamps on Steel Path, and each Undercroft side portal adds 3.
ways.req: The Duviri Paradox; The Steel Path

ways.how: Defeat the Duet boss fight against The Fragmented in Isleweaver and open the chest.
ways.why: 10 Clamps (15 on Steel Path) per clear.

ways.how: Run The Duviri Experience on normal difficulty and defeat the Orowyrm.
ways.why: 10 Clamps per Orowyrm chest, plus 1 per Undercroft side portal.

tips: Resource Boosters do nothing for Clamps, so don't save boosters for this.
Getting everything takes about 1,210 Clamps.
Acrithis sells Catalysts, Reactors, Forma blueprints and Kuva for 10-25 Clamps.

sum: Vosfor buys random Arcane collections from Loid (200 Vosfor each); dissolve unwanted Arcanes and claim the weekly and Syndicate packs.

ways.how: Have Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica dissolve your spare and duplicate Arcanes.
ways.why: The amount varies by Arcane, and leftovers from Eidolons, bounties and collections all become Vosfor.

ways.how: Clear Elite Deep Archimedea with enough Research Points.
ways.why: 20 Vosfor at 28 points and 50 at 37 points.
ways.req: Whispers in the Walls, Cavia Rank 5

ways.how: Buy the 200 Vosfor Pack from any of the six main Syndicates at Rank 5.
ways.why: 200 Vosfor for 30,000 standing, a good use of maxed standing.
ways.req: Rank 5 with a faction Syndicate, Whispers in the Walls

ways.how: Buy 200 Vosfor Packs from Kaya for 6 Pix Chips, and play Faceoff missions.
ways.why: Faceoff awards varying amounts of Vosfor.

ways.how: Complete Calendar challenges and pick the 200 Vosfor Pack when offered.
ways.why: A free 200 Vosfor when it shows up.

tips: Each collection costs 200 Vosfor plus 50,000 credits and gives 3 Arcanes.
Pick the collection with the best odds for the Arcane you want (e.g. Steel Collection is 100% rare).
Spend spare faction standing on Vosfor Packs instead of letting it sit.

sum: Lua Thrax Plasm buys Voruna, Perigale, Sarofang and Lua arcanes from Archimedean Yonta; farm it in Conjunction Survival, best on Steel Path Circulus.

ways.how: Play the Steel Path version of Circulus Conjunction Survival and stay for many rotations, killing the Thrax that spawn every 5 minutes.
ways.why: Guaranteed 6 Plasm per rotation, plus each Thrax has a 30% chance to drop more.
ways.req: The War Within; The Steel Path

ways.how: Run normal Circulus Conjunction Survival and kill the Thrax Centurions and Legatus that spawn each rotation (finish Eclipse/Lua variants with Void Beam).
ways.why: Guaranteed 5 Plasm per rotation, plus 30% Thrax drops.

ways.how: Run Yuvarium Conjunction Survival for an easier version.
ways.why: Guaranteed 3 Plasm per rotation (5 on Steel Path).

tips: Play in a squad: Thrax spawns are 2 plus 1 per extra squad member.
Resource Boosters double Plasm from Thrax drops but not the rotation reward.
Plasm drops despawn after 60 seconds, so grab them fast.
Everything from Yonta once takes 1,110 Plasm.

sum: Archon Shards give permanent Warframe stat boosts through the Helminth; the weekly Archon Hunt is guaranteed, and Netracells and Archimedea add several more each week.

ways.how: Complete the weekly Archon Hunt; the Archon rotates between Boreal (Azure), Amar (Crimson) and Nira (Amber).
ways.why: Guaranteed shard of that Archon's color, with a 20% Tauforged chance that rises 20% after each normal one (about 39.83% effective).

ways.how: Run Netracells from Tagfer in the Sanctum Anatomica, spending a Search Pulse each time.
ways.why: The main cache can be a Crimson, Amber or Azure shard (Tauforged as a rare result).

ways.how: Unlock Deep Archimedea with 2 Search Pulses and clear its three missions with as many Research Points as possible.
ways.why: Its main rewards are Crimson, Amber and Azure shards, with Tauforged as rare loot.
ways.req: Whispers in the Walls, Cavia Rank 5

ways.how: Unlock Temporal Archimedea in Höllvania with 2 Search Pulses and clear it.
ways.why: It can award all six colors, including Emerald, Topaz, Violet and Tauforged.
ways.req: The Hex quest, Rank 5 with The Hex

ways.how: Buy the weekly shard from Bird 3 in the Sanctum Anatomica; its color rotates.
ways.why: One normal shard for 30,000 Cavia standing each week.

ways.how: Pick shards from the 1999 Calendar, and finish Infernum 21 of Steel Path Descendia.
ways.why: The Calendar can give any normal shard; Descendia gives normal Crimson, Amber or Azure.

tips: You get 5 Search Pulses a week, shared between Netracells, Deep and Temporal Archimedea.
Fuse two primary colors for Emerald, Topaz or Violet (50 Stela), or three of a color for a Tauforged (100 Stela).
Shards are lost if you sell or subsume a Warframe that has them, so unsocket first.
Search Pulses and Archon Hunts reset Monday 00:00 UTC.

sum: Granum Crowns open the Granum Void and free Solaris captives; kill the Treasurer on a Corpus Ship, and the planet sets the tier (Venus/Mars/Phobos normal, Jupiter/Neptune Exemplar, Neptune/Pluto/Steel Path Zenith).

ways.how: Run quick non-endless Corpus Ship missions and kill the Treasurer before he escapes; he shows up within 2-4 minutes with a waypoint.
ways.why: Only one Treasurer spawns per mission, so short missions get you a Crown fastest. Non-endless missions spawn him sooner than endless ones (5-8 minutes).

ways.t: Zenith Crowns: Pluto, Neptune or Steel Path
ways.how: Farm Corpus Ship missions on Pluto or Neptune, any Steel Path Corpus Ship mission, or any Sisters of Parvos mission.
ways.why: These drop Zenith Crowns, which open the Nightmare Granum Void and free Solaris for 900 standing. Acheron, Cypress, Hydra and Psamathe are good nodes.

ways.how: Farm Corpus Ship missions on Jupiter, or Adrastea and Triton.
ways.why: Exemplar Crowns open the Extended Granum Void and free Solaris for 600 standing.

ways.how: Farm Corpus Ship missions such as Skyresh, Ishtar, Roche or Fossa.
ways.why: Easy early Crowns for the base Granum Void and 300 Solaris standing per captive.

ways.t: Nightmare Mode to upgrade the tier
ways.how: Play Nightmare Mode Corpus Ship missions, which add +10 enemy levels.
ways.why: The higher level can bump the drop up a tier, e.g. Nightmare Jackal on Venus drops an Exemplar Crown.

tips: Vacuum and Fetch don't pull Crowns; pick them up by hand.
Resource Boosters and loot abilities don't affect Crowns.
You can spend a Crown in the same mission you got it.
The Treasurer doesn't spawn on Valac (Europa) or if you're within 35 m of extraction.

sum: Nightwave Cred buys items from the Nightwave Cred Offerings (Catalysts, Reactors, Kuva, Nitain and more); earn it by ranking up Nightwave through daily and weekly Acts.

ways.how: Complete the Weekly and Elite Weekly Acts each week, including Recovered ones from missed weeks.
ways.why: Weeklies give 4,500 standing and Elite Weeklies 7,000, and every 10,000 standing is a rank.

ways.how: Clear the daily Acts; each lasts 3 days, so you can catch up.
ways.why: 1,000 standing each, and they are the easiest tasks.

ways.how: Rank up through the season's 30 ranks, several of which award Creds, then keep earning standing for prestige ranks.
ways.why: In the current series, ranks 1 and 16 give 150 Cred and several others 50. Each prestige rank after 30 gives 15 Cred.

ways.how: Keep ranking even if you already own a Nightwave-exclusive reward.
ways.why: Duplicate Nightwave-exclusive rewards turn into 50 Cred.

tips: Each series has its own Cred that expires at the end; spend it before then.
Leftover Cred can be sold for 5,000 credits each after the series ends.
The shop rotates every 7 days, so check back for Catalysts and Reactors.
Weeklies refresh Sunday 00:00 UTC.

sum: Stela fuses Archon Shards and ranks up Cavia; it comes from Murmur enemies and Sarcophage containers in Albrecht's Laboratories, with The Fragmented fight a strong farm.

ways.how: Break the Murmur Sarcophage containers in the Murmur tiles of Albrecht's Laboratories; look on ledges and outcrops.
ways.why: Each one is a guaranteed 2-3 Stela.

ways.how: Fight The Fragmented and kill the enemies it spawns, stalling the fight to farm more. Bounty and Deep Archimedea versions spawn more enemies.
ways.why: Its spawned enemies have about a 5% chance each to drop Stela.

ways.how: Play Mirror Defense on Munio and collect Vosphene Glyphs.
ways.why: Every 50 Vosphene Glyphs collected gives Stela.

ways.how: Run Effervo, Nex or Persto in Albrecht's Laboratories and kill Murmur Fragments and Constructs.
ways.why: Murmur enemies occasionally drop Stela, and Sarcophage-opening bounties send you to them.

tips: Run Fissure missions with relics in the Laboratories; bonus Resource Boosters greatly increase Stela drops.
Rogue Necramechs don't drop Stela.
Fusing two primary shards costs 50 Stela, a Tauforged Ascent Fusion 100.

sum: The six Relay syndicates that sell augment mods and syndicate weapons; pledge to one, then do its three daily Syndicate Alerts and grab every medallion for the fastest standing.

ways.how: Do all three daily Syndicate Alerts for each syndicate you are Rank 1 or higher with, and pick up the medallions hidden around the map. Redeem them at the syndicate's Relay enclave.
ways.why: Each alert spawns 8 medallions (500, 1,000 or 5,000 standing each, with one 5,000 guaranteed), about 10,125 standing on average if you find them all. Alert rewards and medallions do not count against the daily cap, so they stack on top of it.

ways.t: Defense and Interception alerts on the right tiles
ways.how: When a Syndicate Alert is Defense or Interception, run it. On the Grineer Galleon, Corpus Ice Planet and Grineer Sealab defense tiles, medallions still spawn.
ways.why: These missions pay a bigger end reward to make up for spawning fewer medallions, and the maps are small, which makes them the easiest and most rewarding alerts.

ways.how: Pledge to a syndicate at the Syndicate segment in your Orbiter, then play any missions that give lots of affinity.
ways.why: 15% of the affinity you earn becomes standing with your pledged syndicate, and its ally gets 50% of that. This is the part limited by the daily cap.

ways.t: Rank up, then rerun the alerts
ways.how: As soon as you have enough standing, rank up with the syndicate.
ways.why: Ranking up resets that syndicate's alerts, so you can run a fresh set of three, with more medallions, the same day.
ways.req: Enough standing and the rank-up sacrifice

ways.how: Play higher-level Disruption missions and trade any Universal Medallions you get at the syndicate you want.
ways.why: Each one is worth 1,000 standing with whichever syndicate you choose, but unlike normal medallions it counts against the daily cap.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC. All six faction syndicates share one cap, and the cap only limits your pledged syndicate.
An Affinity Booster effectively doubles affinity-based standing. Resource Boosters do not double medallions.
Loot Detector, Thief's Wit, Animal Instinct, Golden Instinct and the Parallax's Orokin Eye help you find medallions.

Allied syndicates gain 50% of what you earn, the opposed one loses 50% and the enemy loses 100%. Steel Meridian, Arbiters of Hexis and Cephalon Suda can all be raised together, and so can New Loka, The Perrin Sequence and Red Veil.

sum: Simaris sells Lost & Found items, Riven slots and blueprints for standing that you earn by scanning things; his daily Synthesis target plus stealth scans of high-level enemies is the fastest route.

ways.how: Take Simaris's daily Synthesis task, find and fully scan the target in missions (on the Steel Path if you can), and turn it in after you've finished the rest of the day's farming.
ways.why: The turn-in gives 2,500 standing per daily target and does not count against the daily cap. A fully synthesized target also gives the whole squad several thousand standing, and more at higher enemy levels.

ways.how: Scan high-level enemies on the Steel Path without being noticed, using an invisible Warframe like Ash, Loki, Ivara or Octavia.
ways.why: Standing grows with enemy level and is tripled for stealth scans, which makes this the most effective way to earn Simaris standing.

ways.t: Archwing scanning in Steel Path open worlds
ways.how: Fly your Archwing high over the Plains of Eidolon, Orb Vallis or Cambion Drift on the Steel Path and scan everything below.
ways.why: Enemies can't detect you that high up, so every enemy, turret, animal, Eidolon Lure and world boss scans as a stealth scan, for 300+ standing each.
ways.req: The Steel Path and an Archwing

ways.how: Run Grineer Shipyard missions and scan enemies before they spot you.
ways.why: Enemies there have a short detection range, which makes stealth scans easy.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC. Simaris has no ranks; you can hold up to 125,000 standing.
Don't turn in the daily task while you're at 125,000; the reward is wasted.
Kinetic Siphon Traps from Simaris hold Synthesis targets in place.
Scans from Helios's Investigator give no Simaris standing.
Universal Medallions can be traded to Simaris.

sum: Teshin's Conclave sells PvP mods, cosmetics and skins; daily Challenges and the three Weekly Missions give the most standing because they ignore the daily cap.

ways.how: Win 6 matches, complete 20 matches and finish 10 daily Challenges in the same week.
ways.why: Finishing all three sends you 50,000 Conclave standing plus 100,000 credits, a Stance mod and 10 rare resources. This standing does not count against the daily cap. Resets Friday 00:00 GMT.

ways.how: Check the Challenges dropdown in the Conclave console and complete as many of the up to eight daily Challenges as you can.
ways.why: Challenge standing is bonus standing outside the daily cap, and 'Focused' challenges pay 6,000. Challenges reset at 19:15 GMT.

ways.t: Faceoff Squad vs Squad during Xtra Cheese
ways.how: Play Faceoff at Vehrvod District during Xtra Cheese hours (00:00-02:00, 08:00-10:00 and 16:00-18:00 GMT).
ways.why: Faceoff pays 2,000 Conclave standing for all three objectives (3,000 on the Steel Path), and Xtra Cheese doubles it. You fight Scaldra and Techrot enemies, not other players.

ways.t: Play several matches in one lobby
ways.how: Stay in the same lobby and keep playing any Conclave mode. Wins, kills, killstreaks and goals all give standing.
ways.why: Every match after the first gives everyone a 10% Consecutive Match Bonus, and winning pays more.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC. Challenge and Weekly Mission standing are outside it.
Don't quit matches early: quitting five gives you a demotion penalty, and you earn no Conclave standing for a week.
Private matches give no standing.
Universal Medallions can't be used for Conclave.

sum: The Ostrons of Cetus sell Zaw parts, mining and fishing gear, and Eidolon resources; the highest-tier Konzu bounty you can run, with every bonus objective, is the main source of standing.

ways.how: Take the highest-level bounty your Mastery Rank allows from Konzu and complete every stage's bonus objective.
ways.why: Higher tiers pay more standing per stage, and bonus objectives add extra standing on top. The board shows each bounty's standing before you accept. Repeating a bounty pays standing again.
ways.req: MR 5 for the 40-60 tier; MR 10 and the Steel Path for the 100-100 tier

ways.how: At night, take Konzu's Eidolon Hunt bounty and take down the Teralyst, Gantulyst and Hydrolyst.
ways.why: The three-Eidolon bounty pays 5,000 standing and the Teralyst-only bounty pays 1,000. The Sentient Cores you collect also go to the Quills.

ways.how: Fish for baited species, especially Murkray, Norg, Cuthol and Glappid, and turn them in to Fisher Hai-Luk. Or tranquilize animals for conservation, especially from an Archwing, where they often spawn in groups of three.
ways.why: Both are relaxed solo farms that pay well once you have the right bait and gear.
ways.req: Fishing spear and bait, or conservation gear

ways.how: Run Shrine Defense at Koumei's shrine near the Cetus entrance.
ways.why: Each completion gives 800 Ostron standing.

ways.how: Trade raw gems to Old Man Suumbaat, or turn in a built, max-ranked Zaw to Hok (it doesn't need to be gilded).
ways.why: A cheap way to turn spare materials and leveled gear into standing.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC.
Universal Medallions can be traded to the Ostrons for 1,000 standing.
Field bounties refresh every 150 minutes, so new ones come up often.

sum: The Quills sell Amp parts, Operator gear and arcanes for standing that comes from Sentient Cores; Eidolon hunts are the best source of cores.

ways.how: Hunt Eidolons at night on the Plains of Eidolon. Capture them with Eidolon Lures, destroy their Synovia joints and kill Vomvalysts.
ways.why: Flawless Cores (1,500 standing) drop from captured Eidolons, Exceptional Cores (750) from Synovia joints and Intact Cores (250) from Vomvalysts. Lures drop more cores the tougher the Eidolon, with the Hydrolyst dropping the most.

ways.how: Run Narmer Bounties from Cetus or Fortuna and trade the Narmer Isoplasts to Onkko.
ways.why: Each Isoplast is worth 2,000 standing, and Narmer Bounties have no Mastery Rank requirement.

ways.how: Buy the reusable Exceptional Sentient Core Conversion blueprint from the Quills and craft your Intact cores into Exceptional ones.
ways.why: It costs 500 standing and turns 250-standing cores into 750-standing ones.

ways.t: Sentients on Lua, Veil Proxima and Archon Hunts
ways.how: Kill Battalysts, Conculysts and Brachiolysts on Lua or in Veil Proxima Murex, or collect Intact cores during Archon Hunts.
ways.why: These Sentients drop Intact cores, and sometimes Exceptional ones on Lua and in Murex.

ways.how: Build an Amp, rank it to max and trade it to Onkko (it doesn't need to be gilded).
ways.why: Gives a one-off chunk of standing.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC.
Intact cores are also needed to rank up: 10 for Mote and 20 for Observer.
Universal Medallions can be traded to the Quills.
Golden Instinct finds Sentient Cores.

sum: Solaris United in Fortuna sells Kitgun and MOA parts, fishing and mining gear; Eudico's highest-tier bounties with bonus objectives are the core of the farm.

ways.how: Take the highest-level bounty your Mastery Rank allows from Eudico, complete every bonus objective, and trade the Debt-Bonds you get to Ticker.
ways.why: Higher tiers pay more standing per stage, bonus objectives add more, and the board shows the standing up front. Debt-Bonds are worth 100-500 standing each at Ticker.
ways.req: MR 5 for the 40-60 tier; MR 10 and the Steel Path for the 100-100 tier

ways.how: Take the Exploiter Bounty to fight the Exploiter Orb.
ways.why: It pays 1,000 Solaris United standing, and the Orb drops a Lazulite Toroid worth 12,000 Vox Solaris standing.

ways.how: Fish for Tromyzon, Charamote and Synathid for The Business, or mine Amarast, Thyst and Zodian for Smokefinger.
ways.why: These catches and gems pay the most standing for the effort.
ways.req: Shock spear and bait, or a Sunpoint Plasma Drill

ways.how: Trade max-ranked Kitguns to Rude Zuud or max-ranked MOAs to Legs, or free captured Solaris on Corpus Ship missions using Granum Crowns.
ways.why: A good way to cash in leveled gear and side activities.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC.
Reaching Rank 5 (Old Mate) unlocks the Profit-Taker heists, which also drop Debt-Bonds.
Universal Medallions can be traded to Solaris United.
A cheap Basic Nosam Cutter from Cetus lets you mine gems early on.

sum: Vox Solaris sells Amp parts, Operator arcanes and Profit-Taker components for Toroids; the Exploiter and Profit-Taker Orbs drop the most valuable ones.

ways.how: Use a Diluted Thermia to start the Exploiter Bounty and defeat the Exploiter Orb.
ways.why: It drops a Lazulite Toroid worth 12,000 standing.

ways.how: Do the Profit-Taker heist bounties from the back room behind Eudico and kill the Orb in Phase 4.
ways.why: It drops a Crisma Toroid worth 6,000 standing.

ways.t: Common Toroids at the Corpus bases
ways.how: Farm enemies around the Spaceport (Vega), Enrichment Labs (Calda) and Temple of Profit (Sola). Let a Reinforcement Beacon reach Alert Level 4 so enemies keep spawning.
ways.why: Each common Toroid is worth 1,000 standing. A Resource Booster doubles Toroid drops, and Nekros's Desecrate, Khora's Pilfering Strangledome, Hydroid's Pilfering Swarm, Atlas's Ore Gaze and Ivara's Prowl raise your chances.

ways.how: Run Narmer Bounties and trade the Narmer Isoplasts to Little Duck.
ways.why: Each Isoplast is worth 2,000 standing.

ways.how: Search the secluded parts of Orb Vallis caves for Toroid pickups, or trade a max-ranked Amp.
ways.why: Caves usually hold 2-4 Toroids per run.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC.
To access Vox Solaris, finish the Vox Solaris quest and The War Within, then speak to Onkko once.
Universal Medallions can be traded to Vox Solaris.

sum: The Ventkids sell K-Drive parts and mods; K-Drive races in the Orb Vallis or Cambion Drift give far more standing than trick chains.

ways.how: Find the most rewarding race marked on your map while riding a K-Drive, then run it over and over as fast as you can.
ways.why: Each gate pays 200 and each second left on the timer pays 10. Starting a race costs 5 per gate (125 at most), but that is refunded to your daily cap. Even a 10-gate race beats a 6,000-point trick chain.

ways.how: Chain tricks anywhere you can ride a K-Drive. The big pipe near the Fortuna elevator is a popular spot.
ways.why: You get 25% of a chain's score as standing. A chain is capped at 3,000 points (750 standing) by default, so tricks are mainly for earning race entry fees.

ways.how: Trade Universal Medallions from Disruption to the Ventkids.
ways.why: Each one is worth 1,000 standing.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC.
Extreme Velocity and Nitro Boost make race clears much faster.
Primo Flair raises the trick point limit; Inertia Dampeners raise the base multiplier.
The race selection changes at 00:00 UTC.

sum: The Entrati of the Necralisk pay in Family Tokens you trade to Grandmother; Mother's Tier 5 bounties fill the daily cap in two or three runs.

ways.how: Run Mother's top-tier bounties in the Cambion Drift and trade the Mother Tokens you earn.
ways.why: These bounties give a lot of Mother Tokens; two or three Tier 5 runs are enough to reach the daily cap.

ways.how: Trade your other family tokens to Grandmother for Grandmother Tokens, then turn those in.
ways.why: Grandmother Tokens are worth 3,000 each, 50% more standing than the tokens you trade for them.

ways.how: Give fish parts to Daughter, Cambion Drift gems to Otak, conservation tags to Son, and Drift resources to Father.
ways.why: Daughter, Otak and Father tokens are worth 500 each and Son tokens 1,000, before converting.

ways.how: Check Grandmother's 'Mend the Family' trades and buy tokens with spare Cambion Drift resources.
ways.why: Eight trades are on offer at a time and they change every eight hours.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC.
Grandmother Tokens are also needed to rank up: 10 buy the Seriglass Shard for rank 5.
Universal Medallions can be traded to Grandmother for Entrati standing.

sum: The Necraloid sells Necramech parts and mods for Orokin Matrices; the third-tier Isolation Vault bounty gives the most valuable matrices.

ways.how: Run Mother's highest Isolation Vault bounty and kill every Necramech in stage 3.
ways.why: Tier 3 gives Orokin Animus Matrices worth 5,000 standing each, and more Necramechs spawn the higher the tier. Matrices drop from each Necramech and as completion rewards.
ways.req: Heart of Deimos and The War Within

ways.how: Run the first or second Isolation Vault tier if you're still gearing up.
ways.why: Tier 1 gives Orientation Matrices (1,000 standing) and tier 2 gives Ballistics Matrices (2,500).
ways.req: Heart of Deimos and The War Within

ways.how: Trade Universal Medallions from Disruption to Loid.
ways.why: Each one is worth 1,000 standing.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC.
A Resource Booster doubles Orokin Matrices, and so does Nekros's Desecrate.
Father Tokens are part of the Necraloid rank-up sacrifices.
After Whispers in the Walls you can talk to Loid without switching to your Operator.

sum: The Holdfasts on the Zariman pay standing for Voidplumes; Quinn's Tier 5 bounties (more on the Steel Path) plus the plumes scattered in every Zariman mission are the fastest source.

ways.how: Run the Tier 5 Zariman bounty, on the Steel Path if you can, and collect plumes after the objective is done.
ways.why: Tier 5 gives 5 Voidplume Quills (2,500 standing each). Steel Path bounties give 150% Quills, rounded up, plus a Steel Essence.

ways.t: Halako Perimeter and other short missions
ways.how: Run a short Zariman mission like the Halako Perimeter Exterminate and explore for the 8 plume pickups once the objective is done.
ways.why: Each mission has one Crest (2,000), two or more Vanes (1,000) and Downs (500). Collecting them gives 16,500-19,000 Holdfasts standing per mission outside Void Armageddon.

ways.t: Dormant Void Angels and Melica caches
ways.how: Kill the dormant Void Angel in Zariman missions, and deliver Zarium Accolades to Cephalon Melica caches.
ways.why: A dormant Angel always drops a Voidplume Pinion worth 5,000, and each cache (usually two per mission) gives a Quill worth 2,500.

ways.how: Buy Voidplumes from Archimedean Yonta with Zariman resources.
ways.why: The offers change every 8 hours.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC. Voidplumes can't take you past the Holdfasts daily cap.
Lost Spirit children run to the nearest Voidplume or Accolade; follow them.
Loot Detector, Thief's Wit, Animal Instinct, Golden Instinct and the Orokin Eye make plumes easy to spot.
Universal Medallions can be traded to the Holdfasts for 1,000 standing.

sum: The Cavia sell Qorvex, weapons and Incarnon items; weekly Netracells and Deep Archimedea plus Fibonacci's Steel Path Tier 5 bounties give the most standing.

ways.how: Spend your weekly Search Pulses on Netracells and Deep Archimedea.
ways.why: Each Netracell pays 5,000 Cavia standing, and finishing all three Deep Archimedea missions pays 15,000. You get 5 Search Pulses a week; Deep Archimedea costs 2.

ways.how: Run the top-tier Sanctum Anatomica bounty, on the Steel Path if you can, and grab Voca after both objectives are done.
ways.why: Bounties pay 1,000 standing at Tier 1 up to 5,000 at Tier 5. Steel Path versions pay 150% plus a Steel Essence, and Tier 5 can drop an Echo Voca.

ways.how: Explore any Albrecht's Laboratories mission (except Mirror Defense) and pick up the 8 Voca, then trade them to Loid.
ways.why: Each mission has one Echo (2,000), two or more Bellows (1,000) and Shrills (500). Steel Path Incursions spawn 10.

ways.how: Kill Gruzzlings for Echo Voca, and buy Voca from Loid with Laboratory resources.
ways.why: Loid's offers change every 8 hours.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC. Voca can't take you past the Cavia daily cap.
Voca are often in secret rooms behind breakable vents and grates, and they make a low throat-singing sound.
Golden Instinct and the Orokin Eye are the most efficient ways to find Voca.
Universal Medallions can be traded to the Cavia for 1,000 standing.

sum: The Hex sell Protoframe gear and Antivirus mods; high-tier Höllvania bounties and the weekly Temporal Archimedea give the most standing.

ways.how: Run the highest Höllvania Central Mall bounty you can handle.
ways.why: Bounties pay from 1,000 standing at Tier 1 up to 6,000 at Tier 6 and 7,500 for Tier 7 Antivirus bounties. Steel Path versions pay more and give a Steel Essence.

ways.how: Complete all three Temporal Archimedea missions each week.
ways.why: Finishing all three pays 15,000 Hex standing.

ways.how: Explore any Höllvania mission for its 8 Hex Treasures and trade them to Leticia. In Hell-Scrub, open the Techrot Safe with a Biocode for one more.
ways.why: Each mission has a Big Bytes Pizza (2,500), an Argon Burger Meal (1,500) and six 750-standing treasures.

ways.how: Use a Parazon Mercy on Technocyte Codas.
ways.why: They can give Hex Treasures.

tips: Daily standing cap: 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, tracked separately for each syndicate and reset at 00:00 UTC. Hex Treasures can't take you past the Hex daily cap.
You'll need one of each 750 treasure to rank up to Rank 3 and again for Rank 5, so keep a set.
Treasures make a sound and have a green outline; loot radar mods and Golden Instinct help too.

sum: Kahl's Garrison has no standing: it ranks up once each week you finish Kahl's Break Narmer mission, so it takes four weeks to max.

ways.how: Talk to Kahl at the Drifter's Camp and finish that week's solo Break Narmer mission.
ways.why: Each completion ranks up the Garrison. Missions rotate every Monday at 00:00 UTC, so it takes four weeks to max out.

ways.how: Do the up to 6 bonus challenges in each Break Narmer mission, replaying it to finish any you missed.
ways.why: Stock, which you spend at Chipper, is awarded as soon as you finish a challenge, even if you then abort. Deathless is always one of the challenges.

ways.how: Open the blue Stock crates in the mission and reach extraction.
ways.why: Each crate gives 2 Stock, up to 5 crates (10 bonus Stock) per mission.

tips: Kahl's Garrison is not affected by the daily standing cap, because it has no standing.
Dying in Break Narmer just respawns Kahl at the last checkpoint.
Progress on multi-part challenges is saved between runs.

sum: Nightwave is a season pass ranked by doing Acts; Elite Weekly and Weekly Acts give the most standing, and every rank takes 10,000.

ways.how: Complete both Elite Weekly Acts each week.
ways.why: Each pays 7,000 standing, the most of any Act.

ways.how: Clear the 2 Weekly and 3 Permanent Weekly Acts every week.
ways.why: Each pays 4,500 standing. Weekly Acts refresh every Sunday at 00:00 UTC.

ways.how: Do the Daily Acts as they come in; each lasts 3 days.
ways.why: Each pays 1,000 standing and they're the easiest tasks.

ways.how: Finish your current weeklies so missed Acts from past weeks come back as 'Recovered', three at a time.
ways.why: Weeks you miss don't count against you; you can still earn that standing later.

tips: Ranks take 10,000 standing each; most seasons have 30 ranks, and prestige ranks after that give 15 Creds each.
Creds expire when a Series ends, so spend them at the Cred Offerings before that.
A countdown appears when the season has two weeks left.

sum: Affinity ranks your Warframes, weapons and companions to 30; the fastest way is high-density kill missions like Sanctuary Onslaught, Duviri's Undercroft or stealth-kill runs on Adaro.

ways.how: Talk to Cephalon Simaris and run zone after zone of Onslaught, killing constantly to keep the efficiency meter up.
ways.why: Spawns a huge volume of enemies in a short time, which makes it the best all-round Affinity farm in the game.
ways.req: The New Strange quest; Elite needs a Rank 30 Warframe (or MR30 with a polarized Warframe)

ways.how: Run The Duviri Experience, enter as many Undercroft portals as you can (up to five) and finish with the Orowyrm.
ways.why: Dax in the Undercroft give around 2,000 Affinity each, Eximus around 10,000 with a booster active, and the Orowyrm gives 100,000.

ways.how: Use a stealth or sleep frame (Ivara, Loki, Ash, Octavia, Banshee with Savage Silence, Baruuk's Lull) and chain kills on unaware enemies.
ways.why: Each stealth kill within 30 seconds of the last adds 100% bonus Affinity, up to 500%, and melee stealth kills count double.

ways.t: Steel Path Elara with On Call Crew
ways.how: Join a squad of On Call Crew users (ideally with Kuva Zarr) on Steel Path Elara and stay inside affinity range.
ways.why: A low-effort way to level gear while teammates do the killing; move every couple of minutes so the AFK timer doesn't kick you.

ways.how: Run endless fissure missions and keep cracking relics.
ways.why: Opening relics raises Affinity gain for the rest of the mission, up to 2x Affinity at 16 relics opened.

ways.how: Bring Archwings and Arch-guns to Salacia, or Archwing, Arch-guns and Necramechs to R-9 Cloud.
ways.why: Salacia is the best Archwing leveling spot outside Railjack; R-9 Cloud is the highest-level Empyrean mission and allows all that gear.

ways.how: Play Sortie Eximus Stronghold missions, Descendia Eximus Penances, or Dark Sector nodes for the weapon class you're leveling.
ways.why: Eximus enemies give a large amount of Affinity, and Dark Sectors add bonus Affinity for specific weapon classes.

tips: An Affinity Booster doubles all Affinity gain, and Smeeta Kavat's Charm can briefly triple it.
Get an item to Rank 20 in one mission and finish it: the 125% mission-completion bonus takes it straight to 30.
In a squad, leave max-rank weapons at home; they soak up shared Affinity.
Allies within 50 m (250 m in open landscapes) share every kill's Affinity, so play with crowd-control frames like Saryn, Equinox, Mirage or Volt.
Low and mid-level enemies in big numbers beat high-level ones, since enemy level barely raises Affinity per kill.

sum: Mastery Rank unlocks gear, trades and more; the fastest XP comes from ranking new items (200 per rank for frames, 100 for weapons), plus big one-off chunks from Intrinsics, Junctions and Steel Path nodes.

ways.t: Level new Warframes, companions and weapons
ways.how: Build or buy gear you've never ranked and level it to 30 at a top Affinity spot like Sanctuary Onslaught or the Undercroft.
ways.why: Warframes, companions, Archwings, K-Drives and Necramechs give 200 mastery per rank (6,000 at 30); weapons give 100 per rank (3,000 at 30). Kuva, Tenet and Coda weapons and Necramechs go to Rank 40 with Forma for extra mastery.

ways.how: Rank up Intrinsics through Railjack missions and Duviri activities.
ways.why: Every Intrinsic rank is worth 1,500 mastery: 75,000 for maxing Railjack and 60,000 for maxing Drifter.

ways.how: Clear every node on the Star Chart and beat the specter at each Junction.
ways.why: Each node gives mastery the first time you clear it, and each Junction victory gives 1,000.

ways.how: Clear the Star Chart and Junctions again on The Steel Path.
ways.why: Steel Path nodes award mastery separately from normal ones, and each Junction specter beaten on Steel Path gives another 1,000.

ways.how: Rank Amps, Kitguns, Zaws, MOAs, Predasites and Vulpaphylas to 30, gild them at their vendor, then rank them again.
ways.why: Only the gilded version earns mastery, so every new Prism, Chamber, Strike or companion type is fresh mastery.
ways.req: Access to the relevant open-world vendor

tips: Variants count separately: Braton, MK1-Braton, Braton Vandal and Braton Prime are four sets of mastery.
Re-leveling after Forma gives no extra mastery, except on items that go past Rank 30.
Mastery tests have a 23-hour cooldown after each pass, so take the test as soon as you qualify.
Stack an Affinity Booster while leveling new gear.

sum: Focus unlocks and ranks your Operator's school nodes; the fastest ways are Elite Sanctuary Onslaught with a Focus Lens, Zariman Void Angels and Eidolon hunts for shards that skip the daily cap.

ways.t: Elite Sanctuary Onslaught with a lens
ways.how: Put a Focus Lens on max-rank gear and push through Elite Onslaught zones.
ways.why: Convergence Orbs are granted automatically at the start of each zone after the first, and the boost scales up to 16x.
ways.req: The New Strange; Rank 30 Warframe (or MR30 with a polarized Warframe)

ways.how: Kill Thrax Centurions and Legatus in Zariman, Void Cascade or The Circuit, and Void Angels whenever they appear.
ways.why: Thrax give the whole squad 2,500 Focus, Ravenous Void Angels in Void Armageddon give 7,500, and dormant Void Angels give 15,000.

ways.how: Hunt and capture the Teralyst, Gantulyst and Hydrolyst at night, then turn in the Eidolon Shards for Focus.
ways.why: Shards ignore the daily cap: Eidolon Shards give 2,500, Brilliant 25,000 and Radiant 40,000. Brilliant shards also unbind Waybound nodes.
ways.req: The War Within and a decent Amp

ways.t: Any high-kill mission with a Focus Lens
ways.how: Lens your Warframe (for ability kills) or a weapon (for shared kills) and farm Affinity anywhere.
ways.why: The lens converts a share of Affinity into Focus and spawns Convergence Orbs that give 5,000 Focus instantly and 10x conversion for 45 seconds.

ways.t: Synthetic Eidolon Shards from Sanctuary Onslaught
ways.how: Reach rotation B in Sanctuary Onslaught and convert the Synthetic Eidolon Shards in the Focus menu.
ways.why: Each converts to 5,000 Focus without counting toward the daily cap, on top of the Convergence boost from the run itself.

tips: The daily cap is 250,000 plus 5,000 per Mastery Rank and resets at 00:00 UTC; shards are the only way past it.
Affinity Boosters speed up lens farming, since lens Focus comes from Affinity.
Greater Lenses convert 3% of Affinity versus 2% for a regular lens.
Naramon's Affinity Spike increases melee Affinity, which helps lensed melee weapons.
Focus earned is kept even if you fail or abandon the mission.

sum: Railjack Intrinsics unlock your crew skills (and 1,500 mastery per rank); they come from Affinity earned in Empyrean missions, fastest in squad Survival runs like Lu-yan or Luckless Expanse.

ways.how: Run the Veil Proxima Survival with other players, killing everything and keeping life support up.
ways.why: Great Intrinsics farm with a group; affinity range is infinite in Railjack, so the whole squad benefits from every kill.

ways.how: Stay long on the Venus Proxima Survival, which switches to your regular Warframe loadout once the main objective is done.
ways.why: A popular, low-level way to farm Intrinsics for newer Railjack players.

ways.how: Use stealth to chain kills in Veil Proxima missions.
ways.why: Stealth Kill Affinity Bonus counts toward Intrinsics, multiplying each kill's value.

ways.how: Fix hull breaches, ruptures, fires and electrical faults and forge supplies during any Empyrean mission.
ways.why: Fixing a hull breach gives 400 Intrinsic XP and ruptures, fires and faults give 250 each (1,000 XP is one point).

ways.how: Play Railjack Void Storm fissure missions when they are up.
ways.why: The best place to run Empyrean Affinity farms when available.

tips: Affinity Boosters and Smeeta Kavat's Charm both speed up Intrinsic gain.
NPC crew kills give no Intrinsics, so do the killing yourself.
Points can't be respecced, so plan: Saturn Proxima needs any Intrinsic at rank 5 and Neptune Proxima at rank 3.
Death doesn't lose progress toward the next point.

sum: Drifter Intrinsics improve the Drifter in Duviri (and give 1,500 mastery per rank); the fastest points come from full Duviri runs that end with the Orowyrm, plus Undercroft stages and The Circuit.

ways.t: Duviri Experience ending with the Orowyrm
ways.how: Play through the Spiral's main stages and Undercroft portals, then defeat the Orowyrm.
ways.why: Defeating the Orowyrm gives 15 Intrinsics (22 on Steel Path), Undercroft stages give 6, and main stages give 3.

ways.how: Run The Circuit and clear as many waves as you can.
ways.why: Every completed wave awards 3 Intrinsics, and you earn Circuit tier rewards at the same time.

ways.how: Find the Lost Islands of Duviri fragments while exploring.
ways.why: Each fragment gives 5 Intrinsics.

ways.how: Do side objectives in the Duviri landscape, fish once and play each Shawzin song once per visit.
ways.why: Side objectives give 3 each and fishing gives 4 once per visit.

tips: Affinity Boosters do not affect Drifter Intrinsics.
Points can't be respecced; rank 9 in each tree is the part that helps outside Duviri.
Opportunity raises Circuit Decree and gear choices, and rank 9 unlocks Riven and Kuva picks on the Steel Path Circuit.
Maxing all four trees takes 4,080 points.

sum: A good Amp is built from Prism, Scaffold and Brace parts bought with Quills and Vox Solaris standing; ranking both syndicates unlocks the strongest combos like 177 and 777.

ways.t: Max Vox Solaris for Propa and Certus
ways.how: Raise Vox Solaris in Fortuna to Rank 4 by turning in Toroids, then buy the Propa Scaffold and Certus Brace from Little Duck.
ways.why: Propa is the highest damage-per-shot scaffold and Certus adds +20% critical chance, the core of 177 (Raplak/Propa/Certus) and 777 (Klamora/Propa/Certus).

ways.t: Rank the Quills with Sentient Cores
ways.how: Hunt Eidolons and kill Vomvalysts for Sentient Cores, trade them to Onkko in Cetus for Quills standing, and unlock Raplak, Phahd and Lohrin parts.
ways.why: 143 (Raplak/Phahd/Lohrin) is the best Amp you can build from Quills parts alone, and Quills sell the Virtuos damage arcanes.

ways.how: Finish The New War to receive the Sirocco, pre-gilded with its own Amp slot.
ways.why: A ready-to-use, already-gilded Amp; extra copies cost 100,000 standing from Cephalon Simaris.

ways.how: Buy Raplak, Pencha and Clapkra (111) or Shwaak, Shraksun and Lohrin (223) from Onkko and assemble them.
ways.why: 111 beats the starting Mote Amp against Eidolons, and 223 is easier to use thanks to its AoE.

ways.how: Rank the Amp to 30, gild it at Onkko (Adherent) or Little Duck (Hand), then add Eternal arcanes from Zariman.
ways.why: Gilding unlocks mastery, a Focus Lens and Amp Arcanes like Eternal Eradicate, Logistics and Onslaught.
ways.req: Angels of the Zariman for Eternal arcanes

tips: Building an Amp costs 4,000 credits and gilding costs 5,000 standing.
Madurai's Phoenix Talons, Power Transfer and Void Strike boost Amp damage.
Eternal Logistics plus Vikla-Safor makes 777's energy cost low or free.
Tektolyst Artifact mods from The Old Peace boost Amps further.
Spare Rank 30 or gilded Amps can be donated back to Onkko or Little Duck for standing.

sum: Forma polarizes mod slots so builds fit; most players get the blueprints from Void Relics, with steady extras from Archon Hunts, Daily Tribute and Duviri.

ways.how: Crack relics in Void Fissures and pick Forma blueprints when they come up.
ways.why: Forma blueprints are common (1x) or uncommon (2x) relic rewards, so almost any fissure run can drop them.

ways.how: Complete the weekly Archon Hunt.
ways.why: When Forma comes up it's given in a bundle of 3.

ways.how: Clear tiers of The Circuit on Steel Path.
ways.why: Tiers 1, 3 and 4 can reward a Forma blueprint.
ways.req: The Duviri Paradox and The Steel Path

ways.how: Spend Pathos Clamps from Orowyrm chests, Isleweaver and Undercroft portals on Acrithis's shop.
ways.why: A Forma blueprint costs 10 Pathos Clamps.

ways.how: Buy the 3-Forma bundle when it's in Teshin's 8-week rotation.
ways.why: 3 Forma for 75 Steel Essence.

ways.how: Log in daily.
ways.why: Forma blueprints are a regular login reward.

tips: Search "forma blueprint x 2" in the relic screen to find relics with 2x Forma as the silver reward.
Each Forma takes 23 hours to build (35,000 credits, a Morphic, Neural Sensor, Neurode and Orokin Cell), so keep the Foundry busy.
Built Forma costs 20 platinum (or 35 for three) if you want to skip the wait.
Polarize slots for your heaviest mods first, like Madurai for Serration.

sum: An Orokin Catalyst doubles a weapon's mod capacity; the reliable free sources are Nightwave Offerings, Sorties, Archon Hunts and Acrithis.

ways.how: Do Nightwave acts to earn Nightwave Credits, then buy a built Catalyst from the Offerings.
ways.why: A fully built Catalyst for 75 Nightwave Credits.

ways.how: Finish all three missions of the daily Sortie.
ways.why: Catalyst blueprints are part of the Sortie reward table.

ways.how: Complete the weekly Archon Hunt.
ways.why: Uses a Sortie-like reward pool that includes Catalyst blueprints.

ways.how: Spend Pathos Clamps on Acrithis's shop.
ways.why: A Catalyst blueprint costs 20 Pathos Clamps.

ways.how: Reach Infernum 21 of the Steel Path Descendia.
ways.why: Clearing it awards a Catalyst blueprint.

ways.how: Complete the first Eris Junction task and the Stolen Dreams quest, and log in daily.
ways.why: Each one-off source gives one, and Daily Tribute rolls them now and then.

tips: Building takes 23 hours and 25,000 credits plus Morphics, Gallium, a Control Module and an Orokin Cell.
Forma doesn't remove a Catalyst, so install it early on weapons you'll keep.
Baro's Void Surplus can contain one.
Built Catalysts cost 20 platinum in the Market.

sum: An Orokin Reactor doubles a Warframe's mod capacity; get them free from Nightwave Offerings, Sorties, Archon Hunts and Acrithis.

ways.how: Spend Nightwave Credits on a built Reactor.
ways.why: A fully built Reactor for 75 Nightwave Credits.

ways.how: Finish the daily Sortie.
ways.why: Reactor blueprints are in the Sortie reward table.

ways.how: Complete the weekly Archon Hunt.
ways.why: Its Sortie-like reward pool includes Reactor blueprints.

ways.how: Check Acrithis's shop for a Reactor blueprint.
ways.why: Sometimes available for 20 Pathos Clamps.

ways.how: Reach Infernum 21 of the Descendia.
ways.why: Awards a Reactor blueprint.

ways.how: Log in daily.
ways.why: Reactor blueprints show up as login rewards.

tips: Building takes 23 hours: 35,000 credits, a Morphic, Neural Sensor, Neurode and Orokin Cell.
Forma doesn't remove a Reactor.
Baro's Void Surplus is another possible source.
Built Reactors cost 20 platinum in the Market.

sum: The Exilus Warframe Adapter unlocks a Warframe's utility mod slot; the easiest renewable source is the blueprint from Cephalon Simaris, with Sorties, Archon Hunts and the Steel Path Circuit as free drops.

ways.how: Earn Simaris standing by scanning targets and buy the blueprint.
ways.why: Unlimited blueprints for 50,000 standing each.

ways.how: Clear tiers of The Circuit on Steel Path each week.
ways.why: A blueprint can appear as a tier reward at a 4.43% chance.
ways.req: The Duviri Paradox and The Steel Path

ways.how: Complete the daily Sortie and weekly Archon Hunt.
ways.why: Each has a 2.5% chance to give a fully built Adapter.

ways.how: Check Acrithis's rotating shop.
ways.why: Sometimes sells a built Adapter for 20 Pathos Clamps.

ways.how: Rank Conclave to 5 and buy the blueprint from Teshin.
ways.why: Blueprint for 75,000 Conclave standing.

ways.how: Complete Natah and A Man of Few Words.
ways.why: Each gives a fully built Adapter once.

tips: The blueprint needs 2 Forma, an Orokin Cell and an Argon Crystal and takes 23 hours.
Daily Tribute milestones at 50, 150 and 450 days include one.
Invasions sometimes offer the blueprint.
Built Adapters cost 20 platinum in the Market.

sum: The Exilus Weapon Adapter unlocks a weapon's utility slot; buy the blueprint from any faction Syndicate, or pick it up from the Steel Path Circuit and Acrithis.

ways.how: Buy the blueprint from any faction Syndicate.
ways.why: Unlimited blueprints for 75,000 standing each.
ways.req: Syndicate rank high enough to buy it

ways.how: Clear Circuit tiers on Steel Path.
ways.why: Tiers 1, 3 and 4 can reward the blueprint.
ways.req: The Duviri Paradox and The Steel Path

ways.how: Check Acrithis's rotating shop.
ways.why: Sometimes sells a built Adapter for 20 Pathos Clamps.

ways.how: Buy Requiem I-IV relics from Palladino in Iron Wake and open them in Requiem Fissures.
ways.why: These original relics include the blueprint; each costs 10 Riven Slivers.

tips: The blueprint needs a Forma, an Exceptional Sentient Core and an Orokin Cell, and takes 23 hours.
Exceptional Sentient Cores come from Eidolon Synovia joints.
Baro's Void Surplus and the 1999 Calendar can also give one.
Built Adapters cost 20 platinum in the Market.

sum: Umbra Forma adds an Umbra polarity to a Warframe or melee weapon; the main repeatable source is Teshin's Steel Path Honors shop every 8 weeks, plus three from the MR30 test.

ways.how: Save Steel Essence and buy the blueprint during the week it's in Teshin's rotation.
ways.why: Blueprint for 150 Steel Essence, available one week out of every 8.

ways.how: Reach and pass the MR30 test.
ways.why: Awards 3 Umbra Forma.

ways.how: Rank up through the current Nightwave season.
ways.why: Some seasons include Umbra Forma at certain ranks.

ways.how: Earn Operational Supply standing when the event runs and buy one from Nakak.
ways.why: One Umbra Forma for 20,000 Operational Supply standing.

ways.how: Watch DE's major streams and log in for any follow-up alerts.
ways.why: These sometimes hand out an Umbra Forma or its blueprint.

tips: Building takes 24 hours: a Forma, a Neurode, 500 Kuva and 1,100 Nano Spores.
Steel Path Incursions give 5 Steel Essence each, up to 30 a day, so 150 is easy to save between rotations.
Acolytes in Steel Path missions drop 2 Steel Essence each.
Regular Forma can't add Umbra polarity, so don't overwrite an existing Umbra slot.

sum: Rivens are random, weapon-specific mods; the steady sources are Sorties, Palladino's sliver trade, Archon Hunts and the Steel Path Circuit, then Kuva to reroll them.

ways.how: Finish the daily Sortie.
ways.why: Sorties have a 28% total chance to reward a Riven.

ways.how: Farm Riven Slivers and trade them to Palladino for veiled Rivens.
ways.why: 10 Riven Slivers buy a veiled Riven, up to twice per week.

ways.how: Clear Circuit tiers on Steel Path every week.
ways.why: Tiers 6 and 7 can give a veiled Riven, and Drifter Opportunity rank 9 adds Rifle, Pistol or Melee Rivens to the tier 5 and 10 picks.
ways.req: The Duviri Paradox and The Steel Path

ways.how: Complete the weekly Archon Hunt.
ways.why: Its reward pool includes Rivens.

ways.how: Buy Rifle, Shotgun, Kitgun or Zaw Rivens from Teshin's rotation, or any type from Acrithis.
ways.why: Teshin's rotating Rivens cost 75 Steel Essence; Acrithis sells them for 15 Pathos Clamps.
ways.req: The Steel Path / The Duviri Paradox

ways.how: Combine four unwanted Rivens with a Transmuter for a new veiled one.
ways.why: Two Transmuters come from capturing a Hydrolyst; Palladino sells them for 10 slivers and Loid for 180 Vessel Capillaries.

tips: Rerolling costs 900 Kuva the first time, rising to a 3,500 cap; Kuva Floods give 1,100-1,400 each.
Riven Slivers drop from Eximus above level 30 (2%) and Steel Path Jackals (5%); resource boosters, Atlas, Hydroid, Khora and Wukong help.
Transmute four Rivens of one type to guarantee that type.
Teshin's weekly Veiled Riven Cipher (20 Steel Essence) skips an unveil challenge.
Archgun Rivens cost 35 Vitus Essence from Arbitration Honors.

sum: Primed Mods are stronger versions of standard mods sold mostly by Baro Ki'Teer for Ducats, so farming them means farming Prime parts to turn into Ducats.

ways.how: Visit Baro at the relay he's at and buy the Primed Mods in his stock with Ducats and credits.
ways.why: He arrives every two weeks and stays for 48 hours with a changing stock.

ways.how: Open Void Relics and sell spare Prime parts at the Ducat Kiosks in any relay.
ways.why: Common parts give 15 Ducats, uncommon 45 and rare 100.

ways.how: Keep logging in to reach days 200, 400, 600 and 900.
ways.why: Each milestone lets you pick Primed Fury, Primed Vigor, Primed Shred or Primed Sure Footed (one of three available).

ways.how: Buy Primed Mods from other players in Maroo's Bazaar or trade chat.
ways.why: Lets you grab one Baro isn't selling right now, though the buyer pays a 1,000,000 credit trade tax.

tips: Some Prime parts are worth more Ducats crafted, like Volt Prime Neuroptics (20 to 50) and Nyx Prime Systems (10 to 50).
Intact relics in a full squad are a good Ducat farm; save Radiant relics for parts you want.
The next relay Baro visits shows at every Ducat Kiosk ahead of time.
Daily Tribute Primed Mods can't be traded.

sum: Galvanized Mods are bought from the Arbitrations vendor for Vitus Essence, which you farm in Arbitration missions.

ways.how: Play the hourly Arbitration and stay for several rotations.
ways.why: Each rotation gives 1 guaranteed Vitus plus a 10% chance for 3 more; each Galvanized Mod costs 20 Vitus.
ways.req: Eris Junction task "Equip a Focus Lens"; Rank 30 Warframe

ways.how: Hunt down the shield drones during Arbitrations.
ways.why: Each drone has a 6% chance to drop 1 Vitus.

ways.how: Buy the mods directly from other players.
ways.why: All Galvanized Mods are tradeable, which skips the Vitus grind.

tips: Mods are sold at rank 0, so plan on Endo to rank them.
Any relay's Arbiters of Hexis room has the vendor, no matter your standing.
Galvanized mods can't be equipped alongside their normal or Amalgam counterparts.
Endless Survival or Defense Arbitrations let you stack rotations for more Vitus.

sum: Incarnon Genesis adapters turn older weapons into Incarnon weapons; you get two a week from the Steel Path Circuit, from that week's rotation.

ways.how: Run The Circuit on Steel Path and reach tiers 5 and 10.
ways.why: Tier 5 (1,785 Circuit Progress) gives your first chosen Genesis and tier 10 (5,460) your second, picked from five on rotation each week.
ways.req: The Duviri Paradox and The Steel Path

ways.how: Buy the current week's Genesis from Cavalero in the Chrysalith.
ways.why: Each of that week's adapters can be bought once for 120 platinum, including the resources to install it.

ways.how: Buy Incarnon weapon blueprints from Cavalero with Holdfasts standing, or farm them from Armatus on Deimos.
ways.why: These weapons come with Incarnon forms built in, so they need no Genesis at all.
ways.req: Angels of the Zariman and MR14 (Cavalero); Whispers in the Walls (Armatus)

tips: Check the rotation each Monday at 00:00 UTC and plan which two you want.
Stage 4 gives a 50-progress bonus once per day, so run a few stages every day.
Install the Genesis at Cavalero with Duviri resources; removing it later returns the adapter but not the resources.
A good Amp helps in The Circuit since Amps aren't randomized.

sum: Arcanes are added effects for frames, weapons and Operators; the best come from Eidolon hunts, Steel Path Acolytes, the Zariman, Sanctum Anatomica, Duviri's Steel Path Circuit and newer zones, with Loid's dissolution to recycle extras.

ways.how: Capture the Teralyst, Gantulyst and Hydrolyst at night.
ways.why: Captures drop better arcanes than kills, including Arcane Energize and Arcane Grace.

ways.how: Kill Acolytes as they spawn in Steel Path missions.
ways.why: They drop Primary and Secondary arcanes, plus 2 Steel Essence each.

ways.how: Run The Circuit on Steel Path each week.
ways.why: Tiers 2, 6, 7 and 8 offer Arcane Reaper, Secondary Shiver or Longbow Sharpshot.
ways.req: The Duviri Paradox and The Steel Path

ways.how: Play the Zariman for Cascadia, Molt, Eternal and Emergence; Netracells and Albrecht's Laboratories for Melee arcanes.
ways.why: These zones hold the Operator, Amp and Melee arcanes most endgame builds use.
ways.req: Angels of the Zariman / Whispers in the Walls

ways.how: Dissolve unwanted arcanes into Vosfor and buy collections from Loid.
ways.why: Each collection costs 200 Vosfor and 50,000 credits for 3 arcanes; the Eidolon collection has a 5% legendary chance per slot.

ways.how: Play the mode that drops the arcane you want.
ways.why: Arbitrations hold arcanes like Arcane Pistoleer, Höllvania holds Bellicose, Camisado and others, and Descendia holds Circumvent and Persistence.

tips: Maxing most arcanes takes 21 copies (rank 5); Virtuos, Exodia, Pax and Residual take 10 (rank 3).
Arcanes dropped by enemies count as mod drops, so Steel Path and Mod Drop Chance Boosters raise their chance.
Scavenger Drones destroy Acolyte arcane drops, so don't let one near them.
Primary arcane slots need a Primary Arcane Adapter, which Teshin sells for 15 Steel Essence.

sum: Requiem Mods kill Kuva Liches and Sisters of Parvos; farm Requiem Eterna relics from Kuva Siphons and Floods and open them in Kuva Fortress Requiem Fissures.

ways.how: Run each Kuva Siphon and Kuva Flood mission on the star chart.
ways.why: Siphons have a 50% chance at a Requiem Eterna relic and Floods drop one too, even if you skip the Siphon; you get one per unique mission.

ways.how: Kill your Lich's Thralls or Sister's Hounds while revealing murmurs.
ways.why: Each has a 5% chance to drop a Requiem Eterna relic.

ways.how: Open your Eterna relics in Requiem Fissures, which only spawn in the Kuva Fortress.
ways.why: Requiem Eterna contains every Requiem Mod except Oull.

ways.how: Use the correct Requiem sequence on your Lich or Sister.
ways.why: There's a 25% chance to get Oull, the wildcard Requiem, for the owner of that Lich or Sister.

ways.how: Put four Requiem Mods, including Defiled ones, into Transmutation.
ways.why: Returns a fresh, fully charged random Requiem Mod.

tips: Each Requiem has 3 charges; spent (Defiled) ones are still worth keeping for transmutation.
Requiem Mods are tradeable at any rank, so buying the missing one can be faster.
Unused Requiems break down into 1,000 Endo.
Original Requiem I-IV relics cost 10 Riven Slivers each from Palladino.
